item.title: SC to develop appropriate regulatory frameworks for alternative assets
item.description: Securities Commission Malaysia (SC) said Monday it will develop appropriate regulatory frameworks for alternative assets to provide clarity to market players.

item.title: 2026 tech layoffs reach 45,000 in March, more than 9,200 due to AI and automation – RationalFX
item.description: Data shows that roughly 9,238, or about 20 percent of the 45,363 tech layoffs recorded worldwide since the start of the year, and have been linked to artificial intelligence (AI) implementation and organizational restructuring, RationalFX said Monday.

item.title: Malaysia will increase capital flow to innovative start-ups in high value-add sectors
item.description: The Securities Commission Malaysia (SC) said Monday that it will increase the flow of capital to innovative start-ups in high value-add sectors such as electrical and electronics, data infrastructure and medical devices.

item.title: Vietnam to support up to $570K for “unprecedented” digitalization project
item.description: Vietnam’s Ministry of Science and Technology is considering financial support of up to VND15 billion (about $570,000) for each “unprecedented” digitalization project.

item.title: Indosat takes Indonesia women-led AI startups to Vietnam for market expansion
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) innovations developed by Indonesian women-led startups, such as hospital automation tools and inclusive communication platforms, are approaching Vietnam through a regional expansion initiative led by Indonesia-based Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison under its women-focused innovation program SheHacks.

item.title: Digital Penang aims to aim to enhance founder readiness through structured programs, talent development initiatives & stronger corporate linkages [Q&A]
item.description: We talked to Ng Kwang Ming, Chief Executive Officer at Digital Penang, to learn more about the agency’s achievements in 2025 and its plans and aspirations for 2026.

item.title: Vietnam’s electric motorbike startup Dat Bike secures $4M funding from local securities firm
item.description: Vietnam's electric motorbike startup Dat Bike has secured a $4 million investment from local securities firm Thien Viet Securities JSC, the former announced Monday.

item.title: Editor’s note on using AI in contributed content
item.description: In our experience, the most effective use of AI is often not to generate a finished article in one step, but to support the stages that come before and after the core writing.

item.title: DayOne partners Cortical Labs to develop Singapore’s first biological data center
item.description: DayOne, a Singapore-headquartered data center developer and operator and Cortical Labs, a biological computing startup in Melbourne, announced Tuesday a partnership to build Singapore’s first major Biological Data Center, a first of its kind outside Australia.

item.title: Datacom market boom to boost Malaysia’s tech space – Kenanga
item.description: Kenanga Research said Tuesday that the global datacom market boom will spur Malaysia's technology space.
